description: March 22 birthday meaning: Pisces or Aries cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, March 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Pisces or Aries. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a March 22 birthday
paragraphs: March 22 nearly always places the Sun in early Aries, about one degree in, though the occasional year keeps it on the Pisces side at birth. Master number 22 stays unreduced here. Marrying the double Mars emphasis of this first decan with the master builder, the date is linked with bold, large-scale ambitions approached with energy.

By noon UTC on March 22, the Sun has normally reached roughly 1° of Aries. That places the date in the Aries decan that astrologers give to Mars, the first of three. A birthday around March 19 to March 21 sits on the cusp between Pisces and Aries, the seam where the zodiac ends and begins again. Strictly speaking nobody is half one sign: the Sun is in one or the other, and the exact moment it crosses into Aries shifts by a day or so depending on the year, the time of birth and the place. A full chart settles it. Many cuspers still relate to both, pairing Pisces' imagination and empathy with Aries' urge to act. The blend is often described as a dreamer who also starts things.

sections.heading: Numerology of the March 22 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same March 22 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: March 22 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 22 is the 81st day of the year (82nd in a leap year). In most years Taurus season is under way by April 20, 29 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. March 22 is also the birthday of Robert Andrews Millikan (1868), Reese Witherspoon (1976) and Wilhelm I (1797).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 22?
faq.answer: March 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Pisces or Aries on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Aries. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 22 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 33 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 22?
faq.answer: By March 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 22?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a March 22 birthday are Robert Andrews Millikan (1868), Reese Witherspoon (1976) and Wilhelm I (1797). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
